structure_policy_rationale: Original 图标已经是高度抽象的几何符号，符合 theme_rules 中‘当 Original 是清晰几何符号时保留主体轮廓’的规则。该人形结构具有极高的品牌辨识度，无需进行语义重构，只需将其从平滑矢量转化为手绘涂鸦风格即可。
preserve: 人形Logo的整体拓扑结构：头部的独立圆点、躯干与四肢的连接关系
张开双臂和双腿的欢庆/拥抱姿态
头部圆形与身体弧线之间的负空间关系
图形在画面中的居中布局
must_preserve: 人形Logo的五个主要部件位置关系（头、躯干、四肢）
recompose_allowed: 线条的边缘平滑度（需改为不规则手绘边缘）
图形的内部填充质感（需改为哑光平涂，模拟蜡笔或颜料堆积感）
restyle: 将原始品牌橙色映射为主题色板中的高饱和度砖红或奶黄
去除所有立体光影、渐变和高光，改为纯色块填充
边缘处理为带有抖动感的粗马克笔触
forbid: 禁止保留原始的橙色背景
禁止使用细线条或无描边设计
禁止添加任何立体阴影或高光
禁止改变人形的基本姿态（如变成站立不动或坐下）
禁止使用主题色板之外的颜色（如绿色、紫色、粉色）
禁止保留写实细节或复杂纹理
generation_brief: Retro hand-drawn doodle icon of Dianping's abstract human figure. Centered on pure black background. Subject filled with high-saturation brick red or creamy yellow flat color. Thick, rough, uneven black marker-style outline. No gradients, no shadows, no gloss. Crayon texture, naive art style. Preserve the iconic pose: round head separated from body, arms and legs spread open in a celebrating hug gesture.
color_application: Map original brand orange to theme's high-saturation brick red or creamy yellow. Use solid flat fill only. Background must be pure black (#000000).
stroke_application: Apply thick, irregular, hand-drawn black outlines to all edges of the human figure. Simulate marker pen jitter and varying line width. No smooth vector lines.
composition_application: Center the simplified human figure. Occupy 60-70% of canvas area. Ensure sufficient black breathing space around the subject. Maintain the spatial relationship between the head circle and the body limbs.
identity_application: Strictly preserve the topological structure of the 'celebrating human' symbol (round head, open limbs). Recognize it as the core identity anchor. Do not alter the pose or merge head/body.
fidelity_constraints: Must have thick, rough hand-drawn black outlines
Colors limited to theme palette (Brick Red/Creamy Yellow on Black)
Flat design only: no gradients, shadows, or lighting effects
Subject must look like a crayon/marker doodle
negative_constraints: No fine or smooth vector lines
No change to the fundamental 'open arms' pose
